summary: CyanBridge 2.4.3 makes CyanBridge installable on more devices in Google Play, and includes the 2.4.2 live-preview fixes. Recommended installation: Google Play For most users, the recommended way to install and update CyanBridge is through Google Play: Download CyanBridge from Google Play Google Play provides the simplest update path, automatic updates, and Play Protect checks. Availability of version 2.4.3 may follow the configured Play rollout. The APKs attached below are for users who specifically need direct sideloading. The AAB is for Play Console and testing tracks and cannot be installed directly. Changes Google Play availability: Wi-Fi is no longer a required hardware feature, so Google Play no longer hides CyanBridge from phones, tablets, desktops and Android XR devices that report no Wi-Fi.
